name: noun-castle
prompt: Stylised medieval castle structure. Stout stone keep with crenellated battlements, four corner towers with pointed conical roofs, an arched gateway at the front, banners fluttering subtly from the towers. Pixar-friendly geometry, not photoreal.

name: noun-tower
prompt: Stylised tall slender stone watchtower. Cylindrical with a small arched door at the base, narrow window slits up the height, crenellated parapet at the top, a single small flag flying. Soft-edged stones.

name: noun-cathedral
prompt: Stylised gothic cathedral structure. Symmetrical front facade with two tall towers flanking a central rose window, pointed arched main entrance, flying buttresses at the sides. Pixar-clean stylised stone.

name: noun-cottage
prompt: Stylised small countryside cottage. Stone-and-wood walls under a thick thatched roof, a sturdy wooden door front and centre, two small shuttered windows, a stone chimney with a wisp of smoke. Cute and inviting.

name: noun-lighthouse
prompt: Stylised coastal lighthouse. Tall white-and-red striped cylindrical tower with a glassed-in lamp room at the top emitting a soft warm glow, a small attached cottage at the base, a brass weather-vane on top.

name: noun-bridge
prompt: Stylised arched stone bridge. A single graceful stone arch spanning over implied water, with smooth cobbled walking surface on top, low stone parapets along both edges, weathered stones with soft moss. No surrounding environment.

name: noun-temple
prompt: Stylised oriental temple structure. Tiered pagoda-style roof with upturned eaves, red lacquered wooden columns supporting each level, a small stone staircase at the front entrance, golden ornamental finials on the roof peaks.

name: noun-dungeon
prompt: Stylised dungeon room kit-piece — a single modular tile showing rough stone walls forming three sides of a square chamber with a stone floor, a single torch sconce on one wall casting soft warm light, an iron-banded wooden door at the back.

name: noun-tent
prompt: Stylised camping tent. Conical canvas tent in faded brown with visible stitching, the entrance flap tied open showing a hint of warmth inside, a small bedroll just visible inside, guy-lines pegged into the imaginary ground.

name: noun-windmill
prompt: Stylised wind-driven mill structure. White-washed stone round base with a wooden upper level and conical thatched cap, four large wooden lattice sails attached to the front, a small entrance door at the base.

name: noun-sword
prompt: Stylised single-handed knight's longsword floating in mid-air. Polished steel double-edged blade catching cool studio light, simple crossguard, leather-wrapped grip, a faceted blue gem set in the pommel. Slight 3/4 angle so both the edge and flat are visible.

name: noun-axe
prompt: Stylised two-handed great axe floating in mid-air. Heavy curved steel head with a single crescent blade and a small back-spike, dark wood haft wrapped in leather at the grip with a leather strap loop at the butt. Slight 3/4 angle.

name: noun-bow
prompt: Stylised wooden recurve longbow floating in mid-air. Polished dark wood limbs with subtle silver inlay near the riser, taut bowstring, a leather grip wrap. Held vertically with a slight 3/4 angle showing the curve.

name: noun-spear
prompt: Stylised polearm spear floating diagonally in mid-air. Long dark wooden shaft, leather wrapping near the centre grip, polished steel leaf-shaped spearhead at the top with a small banner tassel below the head.

name: noun-shield
prompt: Stylised round wooden shield with a steel rim floating in mid-air. Painted heraldic emblem centred on the face (a stylised eagle in cool blue and gold), reinforced iron boss in the centre, leather grip-straps visible on the back at a slight angle.

name: noun-pistol
prompt: Stylised semi-automatic pistol floating in mid-air. Sleek matte black slide and frame, polymer grip with subtle texturing, trigger guard, a small front sight, magazine slightly visible at the grip well. Slight 3/4 angle, side profile prominent.

name: noun-rifle
prompt: Stylised assault rifle floating horizontally in mid-air. Matte black polymer body with a foregrip, a fixed stock, an integrated reflex sight on the top rail, a curved magazine inserted. Side profile at a slight 3/4 angle.

name: noun-katana
prompt: Stylised eastern katana floating in mid-air. Long curved single-edged polished steel blade catching cool studio light, traditional black saya (sheath) presented beside the drawn blade, wrapped tsuka (handle) with a diamond pattern. Slight 3/4 angle.

name: noun-dagger
prompt: Stylised short dagger floating in mid-air. Polished steel double-edged blade with a slight serration near the hilt, simple S-curve crossguard, leather-wrapped grip, small ruby gem at the pommel. Slight 3/4 angle.

name: noun-car
prompt: Stylised compact city car. Rounded soft-edged hatchback body in glossy cobalt blue, large friendly round headlamps, small upright greenhouse, simple alloy wheels, a hint of a Pixar-style face in the headlamp grille. Side profile at a slight 3/4 angle.

name: noun-motorcycle
prompt: Stylised sportbike motorcycle. Curved sleek fairing in red and black, dual headlamps, raised handlebars, twin exhaust pipes, a single seat, sport tyres. Side profile at a slight 3/4 angle.

name: noun-bicycle
prompt: Stylised classic pedal bicycle. Cream-coloured curved frame with a leather saddle, dropped handlebars wrapped in leather tape, two thin-spoked wheels, a small front basket with a soft tan finish. Side profile at a slight 3/4 angle.

name: noun-ship
prompt: Stylised wooden galleon ship suspended slightly above a soft cloud of mist (no ocean visible). Three tall masts with rolled sails, ornately carved wooden hull, gun-ports along the side, a stylised figurehead at the bow. Slight 3/4 angle showing the side.

name: noun-plane
prompt: Stylised small propellor aircraft. Streamlined fuselage in cream and red trim, single propellor at the nose, fixed landing gear, twin tail fins, a friendly cockpit window suggesting Pixar character framing. Side profile at a slight 3/4 angle.

name: noun-spaceship
prompt: Stylised sleek sci-fi spaceship. Streamlined wedge body in chrome and cobalt blue with glowing accent strips along the wings, glassed-in cockpit canopy at the front, twin thrust engines at the rear with subtle glow. Slight 3/4 angle, suspended in mid-air.

name: noun-helicopter
prompt: Stylised utility helicopter. Bulbous main cabin with large round windows, single main rotor on a tall mast (blades visible), tail boom with stabilising rotor, twin skid landing gear. Side profile at a slight 3/4 angle.

name: noun-tank
prompt: Stylised heavy battle tank. Wide tracked chassis, sloped armour hull in olive drab, large rotating turret with a long main gun barrel offset forward, commander's hatch visible on top. Slight 3/4 angle, three-quarters facing toward camera.

name: noun-wagon
prompt: Stylised wooden horse-drawn wagon (no horse). Sturdy plank-sided wagon bed with covered canvas top stretched over wooden hoops, four wooden wheels with iron rims, a driver's bench at the front, harness traces hanging empty. Side profile at a slight 3/4 angle.

name: noun-tree-oak
prompt: Stylised stout oak tree. Thick sturdy trunk with gnarled bark, broad rounded canopy of dense layered green leaves, a few visible roots flaring at the base, balanced silhouette. Stylised soft Pixar-clean geometry.

name: noun-tree-pine
prompt: Stylised tall conifer pine tree. Slender straight trunk with reddish bark, tiered triangular canopy of dark green needled branches arranged in distinct layers, a sharp pointed top. Stylised soft Pixar-clean geometry.

name: noun-tree-palm
prompt: Stylised tropical palm tree. Tall slender curved trunk with horizontal banding, a crown of large fan-shaped fronds drooping outward, a small cluster of coconuts beneath the fronds. Stylised soft Pixar-clean geometry.

name: noun-bonsai
prompt: Stylised ornamental bonsai tree. Miniature carefully-pruned tree in a rectangular ceramic pot, a gnarled aged trunk with sculpted small canopies of green foliage, a single moss patch and small pebble at the base of the trunk.

name: noun-mushroom
prompt: Stylised oversized forest mushroom. Plump cylindrical white stalk, a vivid red domed cap with white spots, a slight lift in the cap edge revealing pale gills beneath, soft moss-and-grass tuft at the base.

name: noun-rock
prompt: Stylised mossy boulder. Large rounded grey stone with slightly faceted Pixar-clean planes, patches of soft green moss on the top surface, a few small pebbles scattered at the base, balanced silhouette.

name: noun-waterfall
prompt: Stylised waterfall feature, presented as a small monolithic element on the studio floor. A short tiered stone outcrop with white cascading water flowing down two stepped levels into a small calm pool at the base, light mist softly drifting up. No surrounding environment.

name: noun-mountain
prompt: Stylised single mountain peak. A tall sharp pyramidal summit with snow-capped top fading to grey rock then dark stone at the base, a few subtle ridge lines on the visible faces. Stylised soft Pixar-clean geometry.

name: noun-island
prompt: Stylised tiny tropical island. A small rounded sandy mound with a single palm tree at the centre and a small driftwood log at the edge, a thin ring of bright turquoise water around the sand base. The whole island floats slightly above the studio floor as a hero piece.

name: noun-chest
prompt: Stylised treasure chest. A sturdy wooden chest with iron banding and corner reinforcements, a heavy padlock at the front, the lid slightly ajar revealing a warm golden glow and the suggestion of gold coins spilling out. Slight 3/4 angle so both the lid interior and the front are visible.

name: noun-lantern
prompt: Stylised hand-held oil lantern. A small brass-and-glass lantern with a hinged top, a soft warm flame visible inside through the glass panels, a curved carrying handle on top. Suspended just above the floor in mid-air, slight 3/4 angle.

name: noun-barrel
prompt: Stylised wooden barrel. Standing upright on its bottom, dark wood staves bound with three iron hoops, soft contact shadow on the floor. Slight 3/4 angle so the curve of the side and a hint of the top are visible.

name: noun-crate
prompt: Stylised wooden cargo crate. A simple cubic plank crate with visible nails at the corners and an X-pattern reinforcement on the front face, slightly weathered wood. Slight 3/4 angle showing front, side and top.

name: noun-potion
prompt: Stylised alchemy potion bottle. A small glass flask with a round bottom and narrow neck, sealed with a cork, filled with glowing cerulean liquid emitting a faint soft inner glow, a small paper label tied to the neck with twine. Floating just above the floor.

name: noun-scroll
prompt: Stylised rolled parchment scroll. A partially-unrolled scroll tied with a red ribbon, aged parchment with subtle ink marks visible on the unrolled portion, the two roll-ends in dark wood. Floating just above the floor at a slight angle.

name: noun-crown
prompt: Stylised royal crown. A golden circlet with five tall pointed peaks, each tipped with a small faceted gem (alternating sapphire and ruby), a velvet purple band visible at the base. Suspended in mid-air, slight 3/4 angle showing depth.

name: noun-gem
prompt: Stylised oversized faceted gemstone. A large multi-faceted sapphire-blue crystal floating in mid-air, catching the studio light with sharp specular highlights across its facets, very slight inner glow. Slight 3/4 angle showing multiple facet planes.

name: noun-book
prompt: Stylised hardcover tome. A thick leather-bound book lying closed flat on its side, deep cordovan brown leather cover with embossed gold filigree and a stylised central emblem, brass corner reinforcements, a silk ribbon bookmark tail just visible. Slight 3/4 angle.

name: noun-torch
prompt: Stylised hand-held torch. A short wooden haft wrapped in leather at the grip, a wrapped-cloth bundle at the top dipped in oil emitting a vibrant warm flame, faint heat-haze and a hint of smoke trailing upward. Floating diagonally in mid-air.

name: noun-portal
prompt: Stylised magical portal. A vertical oval-shaped gateway about figure-height, edged with carved stone runes glowing faintly cobalt-blue, the interior of the portal shimmering as a swirling blue-and-violet vortex with subtle inward motion lines and a few floating particles. Self-contained on the studio floor, no other props.
